The csv file Neuropathic_pairwise_44.csv contains neuropathic pain diagnosis records in the form of tables of which the row represents different patients and the column represents different diagnostic labels.

Which cause-and-effect relationship is more likely?
A. lower abdominal discomfort causes R T11 radiculopathy

content.text:
Radiculopathy is a pathophysiological diagnosis and abdominal discomfort is a symptom. A nerve root lesion at R T11 can plausibly produce lower abdominal discomfort. The reverse direction, where a symptom causes the nerve root lesion, makes no physiological sense. I did not run a statistical test on the data, so this rests on that domain reasoning.

ANSWER: B
